import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import os
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

# Disable progress bars and warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data from correct path
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv", low_memory=False)
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv", low_memory=False)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(
    f"Target classes: {train['Cover_Type'].value_counts().sort_index().index.tolist()}"
)

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Prepare features
feature_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X_train = train[feature_cols]
y_train = train["Cover_Type"]
X_test = test[feature_cols]

# Hold out validation split (random split maintains representative distribution)
X_train_holdout, X_train_valid, y_train_holdout, y_train_valid = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

print(f"Train holdout: {X_train_holdout.shape}, Validation: {X_train_valid.shape}")

# Train HistGradientBoosting model with optimized hyperparameters for large data
# Note: n_jobs parameter removed as it was deprecated in newer sklearn versions
model = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
    max_iter=100,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    min_samples_leaf=100,
    l2_regularization=0.1,
    max_bins=255,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=False,
)

# Fit model on hold-out training data only (never sees validation)
print("Training model on hold-out data...")
model.fit(X_train_holdout, y_train_holdout)

# Evaluate on validation set (genuine hold-out estimate)
y_pred_valid = model.predict(X_train_valid)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_train_valid, y_pred_valid)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Make final predictions on test set
print("Making predictions on test set...")
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_predictions})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission preview:\n{submission.head()}")
print(f"\nFinal validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
